# Following an initial, rapid increase, selected lines have continued to increase mean-apparent-flying speed by 14.7 cm/s per 100 generations for over 600 generations

Selection started on or before 1991 and continued until 2023.

```{r}
#| label: import-historic-wind-tunnel-data
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| eval: true

subfolder <- "wind tunnel"
filename <- "CURRENT WIND TUNNEL GENERATION MEANS.xlsx"
in_path <- here(data_folder, subfolder, filename)

wt_wide <- read_xlsx(in_path,
                sheet = "Sheet1",
                range = "A1:E505") |>
#  clean_names() |>
  data.table()
wt_wide <- wt_wide[gen != ""]
wt <- melt(wt_wide,
           id.vars = "gen",
           measure.vars = c("AA1-1",
                            "AA1-2",
                            "AA2-1",
                            "AA2-2"),
           variable.name = "id",
           value.name = "mafs")
wt[, line := substr(id,1,3)]
wt <- na.omit(wt)

# compute line means (in some generations there were two runs per line)
line_means <- wt[, .(mafs = mean(mafs)),
                 by = .(gen, line)]
aa_mean <- line_means[, .(mafs = mean(mafs)),
                 by = .(gen)]

```

```{r}
#| label: long-term-evolution-models
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| eval: true

wt_line_means <- wt[, .(mafs = mean(mafs)), by = .(line, gen)]
wt_means <- wt_line_means[, .(mafs = mean(mafs)), by = .(gen)]
# exponential model with asymptote
m_exp <- nls(
  mafs ~ v0 + A * (1 - exp(-k * gen)),
  data = wt_means,
  start = list(v0 = 0, A = 260, k = 0.015)
)

# two part exponential model
m_two <- nls(
  mafs ~ v0 + A * (1 - exp(-k * gen)) +
    b * gen,
  data = wt_means,
  start = list(
    v0 = 0,
    A = 170,
    k = 0.025,
    b = 0.12
  )
)

# hyperbolic (asymptotic) model
m_hyp <- nls(
  mafs ~ v0 + A * gen / (h + gen),
  data = wt_means,
  start = list(v0 = 0, A = 300, h = 100)
)

# power law (declining but not asymptotic) model
m_power <- nls(
  mafs ~ v0 + A * ((1 + c * gen)^p - 1),
  data = wt_means,
  start = list(v0 = 0, A = 100, c = 0.02, p = 0.4),
  algorithm = "port",
  lower = c(v0 = -50, A = 0, c = 0.000001, p = 0.001),
  upper = c(v0 = 100, A = 1000, c = 1, p = 0.999),
  control = nls.control(maxiter = 500)
)

# m_double <- nls(
#   mafs ~ v0 +
#     A1 * (1 - exp(-k1 * gen)) +
#     A2 * (1 - exp(-k2 * gen)),
#   data = wt,
#   start = list(
#     v0 = 0,
#     A1 = 170,
#     k1 = 0.03,
#     A2 = 130,
#     k2 = 0.002
#   ),
#   control = nls.control(maxiter = 500)
# )

AIC(m_exp, m_two, m_hyp, m_power)

# account for autocorrelation
acf(resid(m_two))
wt_means <- wt_means[order(wt_means$gen), ]

#1. fit model with correlated errors
k <- coef(m_two)["k"]
wt_means$exp_term <- 1 - exp(-k * wt_means$gen)
m_gls <- gls(
  mafs ~ exp_term + gen,
  data = wt_means,
  correlation = corCAR1(form = ~ gen),
  method = "ML"
)
# 2. reestimate k using profile likelihood
fit_k <- function(k) {

  dat <- wt_means
  dat$exp_term <- 1 - exp(-k * dat$gen)
  fit <- gls(
    mafs ~ exp_term + gen,
    data = dat,
    correlation = corCAR1(form = ~ gen),
    method = "ML",
    control = glsControl(msMaxIter = 200)
  )

  -as.numeric(logLik(fit))
}
opt <- optimize(
  fit_k,
  interval = c(0.005, 0.08)
)
opt$minimum
# 2.5 refit at estimated k
k_hat <- opt$minimum
wt_means$exp_term <- 1 - exp(-k_hat * wt_means$gen)
m_gls <- gls(
  mafs ~ exp_term + gen,
  data = wt_means,
  correlation = corCAR1(form = ~ gen),
  method = "ML"
)
summary(m_gls)
# 3. check the autocorrelation
acf(resid(m_gls, type = "normalized"))
# final checks
summary(m_gls)$tTable
intervals(m_gls, which = "coef")

# predicted for plots
pred <- data.frame(
  gen = seq(0, max(wt$gen), length.out = 1061)
)
pred$exp <- predict(m_exp, newdata = pred)
pred$two <- predict(m_two, newdata = pred)

k <- coef(m_two)["k"]
pred$exp_term <- 1 - exp(-k * pred$gen)
pred$mafs <- predict(m_gls, newdata = pred)
```

Concerns:

The AA1 and AA2 lines have remarkably similar fit, which could result from

1. Climate (temperature/humidity) fluctuations in the room during selection runs
2. Climate (temperature/humidity/light) fluctions in the rearing room. Since 2001 the temperature and humidity have been well controlled.
3. Husbandry modifications
4. Gene flow between lines

### Linear mixed model

```{r}
#| label: exp1-lmm-random-intercept
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| eval: true

exp1_lmm <- lmer(wind_speed ~ treatment * sex + (1 | line), data = exp1)
```

```{r }
#| label: exp1-lmm-stats
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| eval: true

exp1_sigma <- summary(exp1_lmm)$sigma

exp1_emm <- emmeans(exp1_lmm, specs = c("treatment", "sex"))

cn_f <- c(1,0,0,0)
aa_f <- c(0,1,0,0)
cn_m <- c(0,0,1,0)
aa_m <- c(0,0,0,1)
exp1_contrast <- list(
  list("F: AA - CN" = aa_f - cn_f),
  list("M: AA - CN" = aa_m - cn_m)
)

exp1_pairs <- contrast(exp1_emm,
                      method = exp1_contrast,
                      adjust = "none") |>
  summary(infer = TRUE) |>
  data.table()
# standardized effect
exp1_pairs[, effect_std := estimate / exp1_sigma]

# percent effect
exp1_cn_means <- summary(exp1_emm)[c(1,3), "emmean"]
exp1_pairs[, effect_perc := estimate / exp1_cn_means * 100]

# reorder for plot
exp1_pairs[, contrast := factor(contrast,
                                levels = c("M: AA - CN",
                                           "F: AA - CN"))]
```

```{r }
#| label: exp1-conditional-mean-plot
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| eval: true

means_plot <- function(plot_sex = "F", title = "Female"){
  offset <- 0.15
  x_breaks <- c(1-offset, 1+offset, 2-offset, 2+offset)
  
  plot_data <- exp1[, .SD, .SDcols = c("treatment", "line", "sex", "wind_speed")]
  treatment_means <- exp1_emm |> 
    summary() |>
    data.table()
  treatment_means[treatment == "CN", x := 1]
  treatment_means[treatment == "AA", x := 2]
  plot_data[line == "CN2", x := 1 + offset]
  plot_data[line == "CN1", x := 1 - offset]
  plot_data[line == "CN2", x := 1 + offset]
  plot_data[line == "AA1", x := 2 - offset]
  plot_data[line == "AA2", x := 2 + offset]
  newdat[line == "CN1", x := 1 - offset]
  newdat[line == "CN2", x := 1 + offset]
  newdat[line == "AA1", x := 2 - offset]
  newdat[line == "AA2", x := 2 + offset]
  
  gg <- ggplot(data = plot_data[sex == plot_sex],
               aes(x = x,
                   y = wind_speed,
                   color = treatment)) +
    
    # raw data
    # geom_sina(maxwidth = 0.5,
    #           color = "gray") +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.05,
                height = 0,
                color = "gray") +
    
    # line means
    geom_point(data = newdat[sex == plot_sex],
               aes(x = x,
                   y = fit),
               size = 2) +
    
    # treatment means and CI
    geom_point(data = treatment_means[sex == plot_sex],
               aes(x = x,
                   y = emmean),
               size = 3) +
    geom_errorbar(data = treatment_means[sex == plot_sex],
                  aes(x = x,
                      y = emmean,
                      ymin = lower.CL,
                      ymax = upper.CL),
                  width = 0) +
    
    # clean plot
    ylab("Max Opposing Wind Speed (cm/s)") +
    scale_color_manual(values = pal_okabe_ito) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = x_breaks,
                       labels = c("CN1", "CN2", "AA1", "AA2")) +
    theme_pubr() +
    theme(legend.position="none",
          axis.title.x = element_blank()) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(90, 210),
                    xlim = c(0.7, 2.3)) +
    ggtitle(title)
  return(gg)
}

gg_f <- means_plot(plot_sex = "F", title = "Female")
gg_m <- means_plot(plot_sex = "M", title = "Male")
plot_grid(gg_f, gg_m, ncol = 2)
```

## Experiment 2 (Wheeler) data

```{r }
#| label: exp2-clean-his-files
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| eval: false
 
# this chunk is to check and clean all of Jess' excel files, which had duplicate entries
subfolder <- "burst speed/jess wheeler/sent from jess/raw"
filename <- "02.14.10.xlsx"
in_path <- here(data_folder, subfolder, filename)

  file_i <- read_xlsx(in_path,
                    range = "a1:c1000") |>
    clean_names() |>
    data.table() |>
    na.omit()
  # angle is flight angle in degrees from 1,0
  # length is flight distance over 1 frame
  colnames(file_i)[1] <- "id"
  file_i[, treatment := substr(id,1,2)]
  file_i[, line := substr(id,1,3)]
  file_i[, sex := substr(id, 4,4)]
  file_i[, dial := substr(id, 5,6) |> as.integer()]
  file_i[, date := substr(id, 8,15)]
 
  check_n <- file_i[, .(N = .N),
     by = .(date, sex, treatment, line, id)]
  check_n[N >=6, id]

  check_id <- check_n[, .(N = .N), 
     by = .(date, sex, treatment, line)]
setorder(check_id, sex, treatment, line, date)

```

```{r }
#| label: exp2-import-cleaned
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| eval: true
 
subfolder <- "burst speed/jess wheeler/sent from jess/raw"
subfolder_path <- here(data_folder, subfolder)

files <- list.files(
  path = subfolder_path,
  pattern = "\\.xlsx$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

exp2 <- data.table(NULL)

for(i in 1:length(files)){
  in_path <- files[i]
  
  file_i <- read_xlsx(in_path,
                    range = "a1:c1000") |>
    clean_names() |>
    data.table() |>
    na.omit()
  # angle is flight angle in degrees from 1,0
  # length is flight distance over 1 frame
  colnames(file_i)[1] <- "id"
  file_i[, treatment := substr(id,1,2)]
  file_i[, line := substr(id,1,3) |> 
           toupper() |>
           factor()]
  file_i[, sex := substr(id, 4,4) |> 
           toupper() |>
           factor()]
  file_i[, dial := substr(id, 5,6) |> as.integer()]
  file_i[, date := substr(id, 8,15)]
  
  # performance measures
  file_i[, theta := ifelse(angle < 0,
                         -(angle + 180),
                         180-angle)]
  file_i[, wind_jess := 7.3888 * dial]
  file_i[, wind_jaw := 6.42237212 * dial]
  file_i[, disp.x := length * cos(theta * pi/180)]
  file_i[, disp.y := length * sin(theta * pi/180)]
  file_i[, wind.x := wind_jess / 30]
  file_i[, vel := sqrt((wind.x + disp.x)^2 + disp.y^2) * 30]
  
  exp2 <- rbind(exp2, file_i)
  
}

  # clean treatments and make factor
  exp2[treatment == "aa", treatment := "AA"]
  exp2[treatment == "cn", treatment := "CN"]
  # exp2[treatment == "k4", treatment := "K45"]
  # exp2[treatment == "n6", treatment := "N60"]
  exp2[treatment == "k4", treatment := "Wild"]
  exp2[treatment == "n6", treatment := "Wild"]
  exp2[, treatment := factor(treatment, levels = 
                                 c("CN", "Wild", "AA"))]
  exp2[, line := factor(line, 
                        levels = c("CN1", "CN2",
                                   "K45", "N60",
                                   "AA1", "AA2"))]
  exp2[treatment == "AA", group := "Selection"]
  exp2[treatment == "CN", group := "No Selection"]
  exp2[treatment == "Wild", group := "Wild"]
  exp2[, group := factor(group,
                         levels = c("No Selection",
                                    "Selection",
                                    "Wild"))]

```

```{r }
                     by = .(id, treatment, line, sex, group)]
```

### Estimate Treatment Effects

```{r }
#| label: exp2-lmm-random-intercept
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| eval: true

exp2_lmm <- lmer(wind_speed ~ treatment * sex + (1 | line), data = exp2_primary)
coef(summary(exp2_lmm))
exp2_sigma <- summary(exp2_lmm)$sigma

exp2_emm <- emmeans(exp2_lmm, specs = c("treatment", "sex"))

cn_f <- c(1,0,0,0,0,0)
wild_f <- c(0,1,0,0,0,0)
aa_f <- c(0,0,1,0,0,0)
cn_m <- c(0,0,0,1,0,0)
wild_m <- c(0,0,0,0,1,0)
aa_m <- c(0,0,0,0,0,1)

# contrasts of interest - this is all contrasts, just not m v f
# aa - cn # primary contrast
# aa - k45 # secondary contrast testing comparison with newer line
# aa - n60 # secondary contrast testing comparison with newer line
# cn - k45 # secondary contrast testing loss in cn
# cn - n60 # secondary contrast testing loss in cn
# n60 - k45 # n60 is july 2009 and k45 is july 2008

exp2_contrasts <- list(
  list("F: AA - CN" = aa_f - cn_f),
  list("F: AA - WT" = aa_f - wild_f),
  list("F: CN - WT" = cn_f - wild_f),
  list("M: AA - CN" = aa_m - cn_m),
  list("M: AA - WT" = aa_m - wild_m),
  list("M: CN - WT" = cn_m - wild_m)
)

exp2_pairs <- contrast(exp2_emm,
                      method = exp2_contrasts,
                      adjust = "none") |>
  summary(infer = TRUE) |>
  data.table()
exp2_pairs[, effect_std := estimate / sigma]
# set up order for effects plot
exp2_pairs[, contrast := factor(contrast,
                                levels = c("M: CN - WT",
                                           "M: AA - WT",
                                           "M: AA - CN",
                                           "F: CN - WT",
                                           "F: AA - WT",
                                           "F: AA - CN"))]

exp2_emm
exp2_pairs
```

```{r }
means_plot_dots <- function(plot_sex = "F", title = "Female"){
  offset <- 0.25
  x_breaks <- c(1-offset, 1+offset, 2-offset, 2+offset,
                3-offset, 3+offset)
  
  plot_data <- exp2_primary[, .SD, .SDcols = c("treatment", "line", "sex", "wind_speed")]
  treatment_means <- exp2_emm |> 
    summary() |>
    data.table()
  treatment_means[treatment == "CN", x := 1]
  treatment_means[treatment == "Wild", x := 2]
  treatment_means[treatment == "AA", x := 3]
  plot_data[line == "CN1", x := 1 - offset]
  plot_data[line == "CN2", x := 1 + offset]
  plot_data[line == "K45", x := 2 - offset]
  plot_data[line == "N60", x := 2 + offset]
  plot_data[line == "AA1", x := 3 - offset]
  plot_data[line == "AA2", x := 3 + offset]
  newdat[line == "CN1", x := 1 - offset]
  newdat[line == "CN2", x := 1 + offset]
  newdat[line == "K45", x := 2 - offset]
  newdat[line == "N60", x := 2 + offset]
  newdat[line == "AA1", x := 3 - offset]
  newdat[line == "AA2", x := 3 + offset]

  gg <- ggplot(data = plot_data[sex == plot_sex],
               aes(x = x,
                   y = wind_speed,
                   color = treatment)) +
    
    # raw data
    # geom_sina(maxwidth = 0.5,
    #           color = "gray") +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.05,
                height = 0.5,
                size = 0.2,
                color = "gray") +

    # line means
    geom_point(data = newdat[sex == plot_sex],
               aes(x = x,
                   y = fit),
               size = 2) +
    
    # treatment means and CI
    geom_point(data = treatment_means[sex == plot_sex],
               aes(x = x,
                   y = emmean),
               size = 3) +
    geom_errorbar(data = treatment_means[sex == plot_sex],
                  aes(x = x,
                      y = emmean,
                      ymin = lower.CL,
                      ymax = upper.CL),
                  width = 0) +
    
    # clean plot
    ylab("Max Opposing Wind Speed (cm/s)") +
    scale_color_manual(values = c(pal_okabe_ito[1],
                                  pal_okabe_ito[3],
                                  pal_okabe_ito[2])) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = x_breaks,
                       labels = c("CN\n1", "CN\n2",
                                  "Wild\nK45", "Wild\nN60",
                                   "AA\n1", "AA\n2")) +
    theme_pubr() +
    theme(legend.position="none",
          axis.title.x = element_blank()) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 250),
                    xlim = c(0.7, 3.3)) +
    ggtitle(title)
  return(gg)
}
```

```{r}
read_weights <- function(file_path,
                         sheet_i,
                         range_i,
                         generation_i,
                         n_flies = 20,
                         del_col = NA){
  
  dt_wide <- read_excel(file_path,
                        sheet = sheet_i,
                        range = range_i) |>
    data.table()
  if(!is.na(del_col)){
    dt_wide[, c(del_col) := NULL]
  }
  colnames(dt_wide)[1] <- "set"
  lines <- colnames(dt_wide)[-1]
  dt_long <- melt(dt_wide,
                  id.vars = "set",
                  measure.vars = lines,
                  variable.name = "line_sex",
                  value.name = "vial_weight")
  dt_long[, fly_weight := vial_weight/n_flies * 1000] # 20 flies per vial
  dt_long[, c("line", "sex") := tstrsplit(line_sex, "-")]
  dt_long[, treatment := substr(line, 1, 2)]
  dt_long[treatment == "AA", treatment := "SEL"]
  dt_long[, generation := generation_i]
  return(dt_long)
  
}
```

```{r }
#| label: wing-head-thorax-lmm-model
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| eval: true

# lmm

wht_lmm <- function(wht, # the data.table
                    y_col = "area", 
                    sex_i = "F"){
  r_form <- paste(y_col,
                  "~ treatment * temp * sex * rep +",
                  "(1 | line)") |>
    as.formula()
  wht_lmm <- lmer(r_form, data = wht)
  sigma <- summary(wht_lmm)$sigma
  
  # emm for statistics (pooled over rep)
  wht_emm.t.s <- emmeans(
    wht_lmm,
    ~ treatment | temp * sex
  )
  # emm for plot (not pooled over rep)
  wht_emm.t.s.r <- emmeans(
    wht_lmm,
    ~ treatment | temp * sex * rep
  )

  # contrast
  wht_pairs <- contrast(
    wht_emm.t.s,
    method = "revpairwise",
    adjust = "none"
  ) |>
    summary(infer = TRUE) |>
    data.table()
  
  # percent and standardized difference
    WT_means <- summary(wht_emm)[summary(wht_emm)$treatment == "WT", "emmean"]

  wht_pairs[, d_perc := estimate / WT_means * 100]
  wht_pairs[, d_std := estimate / sigma]
  wht_pairs[, label := sprintf("\u0394 = %+.3f\n%+.1f%%\n%+.2f SD",
                              estimate, d_perc, d_std)]
  wht_pairs[, x := as.integer(temp)]

  wht_out <- list(
    model = wht_lmm,
    emm.t.s = wht_emm.t.s,
    emm.t.s.r = wht_emm.t.s.r,
    pairs = wht_pairs
  )

  return(wht_out)
  
}
```

```{r }
                       labels = c("23°", "26°", "29°")) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0.5, 3.5),
                    ylim = c(min_y - add_y, max_y + 4*add_y)) +
    theme_pubr() +
    theme(legend.position="none",
      axis.title.x = element_blank()) +
    NULL
  return(gg)
  
}
```

# Evolution of wing size and shape in selected lines is small (about 1% difference), at least relative to flight performance and body size

For wing anatomy, see https://flybase.org/reports/FBim0000853?utm_source=chatgpt.com

and especially
https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11457947/?utm_source=chatgpt.com

```{r }
#| label: wing-metrics
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| eval: true

wing_metrics <- function(x, y, hinge = 1, tip = 17) {

  ## ------------------------------------------------------------
  ## 1. Translate so hinge (LM1) is at the origin
  ## ------------------------------------------------------------

  x0 <- x - x[hinge]
  y0 <- y - y[hinge]


  ## ------------------------------------------------------------
  ## 2. Rotate so hinge -> tip (LM17) is the radial x-axis
  ## ------------------------------------------------------------

  theta <- atan2(y0[tip], x0[tip])

  xr <-  x0 * cos(theta) + y0 * sin(theta)
  yr <- -x0 * sin(theta) + y0 * cos(theta)

  ## Wing length: hinge -> tip
  R <- sqrt(x0[tip]^2 + y0[tip]^2)


  ## ------------------------------------------------------------
  ## 3. Polygon integrals
  ## ------------------------------------------------------------

  # next vertex around perimeter
  x2 <- c(xr[-1], xr[1])
  y2 <- c(yr[-1], yr[1])

  cross <- xr * y2 - x2 * yr

  # signed area
  As <- sum(cross) / 2

  # make formulas independent of clockwise/counterclockwise digitizing
  s <- sign(As)
  A <- abs(As)

  # centroid
  xbar <- sum((xr + x2) * cross) / (6 * As)
  ybar <- sum((yr + y2) * cross) / (6 * As)

  # second moments of AREA about hinge-defined axes
  #
  # Ixx = integral y^2 dA   (chordwise distribution)
  # Iyy = integral x^2 dA   (radial distribution)
  #
  Ixx <- s * sum(
    (yr^2 + yr*y2 + y2^2) * cross
  ) / 12

  Iyy <- s * sum(
    (xr^2 + xr*x2 + x2^2) * cross
  ) / 12

  # product moment
  Ixy <- s * sum(
    (2*xr*yr + xr*y2 + x2*yr + 2*x2*y2) * cross
  ) / 24


  ## ------------------------------------------------------------
  ## 4. Derived wing metrics
  ## ------------------------------------------------------------

  # Ray-style / single-wing aspect ratio convention
  AR <- R^2 / A

  # mean chord
  mean_chord <- A / R

  # radial position of area centroid
  xbar_hat <- xbar / R

  # radius of second moment of area
  r2 <- sqrt(Iyy / A)

  # nondimensional radius of second moment
  r2_hat <- r2 / R
  
  # nondimensional second moment of area
  r2_hat_sq <- Iyy / (A * R^2)


  ## ------------------------------------------------------------
  ## 5. Return results
  ## ------------------------------------------------------------

  data.table(
    area       = A,
    wing_length = R,
    mean_chord = mean_chord,
    aspect_ratio = AR,

    xbar       = xbar,
    ybar       = ybar,
    xbar_hat   = xbar_hat,

    Ixx        = Ixx,
    Iyy        = Iyy,
    Ixy        = Ixy,

    r2         = r2,
    r2_hat     = r2_hat,
    r2_hat_sq  = r2_hat_sq
  )
}

```

```{r }
#| label: radial-area-distribution
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| eval: true

# this function is to compare areas along the span vs. Chicoine/Harmon polygons. Harmon found AA flies have smaller proximal polygon but the radial analysis and especially the superimposition simply shows that the main part of the wing starts more distally in AA.

radial_area_distribution <- function(x, y, hinge = 1, tip = 17,
                                     q = seq(0, 1, by = 0.05)) {

  ## Translate hinge to origin
  x0 <- x - x[hinge]
  y0 <- y - y[hinge]

  ## Rotate hinge -> tip onto x-axis
  theta <- atan2(y0[tip], x0[tip])

  xr <-  x0 * cos(theta) + y0 * sin(theta)
  yr <- -x0 * sin(theta) + y0 * cos(theta)

  ## Wing length
  R <- sqrt(x0[tip]^2 + y0[tip]^2)

  ## Close polygon for sf
  xy <- cbind(xr, yr)
  xy <- rbind(xy, xy[1, ])

  wing <- st_polygon(list(xy))

  total_area <- as.numeric(st_area(wing))

  ## Bounds safely beyond wing
  ymin <- min(yr) - R
  ymax <- max(yr) + R
  xmin <- min(xr) - R

  ## For each q, calculate area with x/R <= q
  cumulative_area <- sapply(q, function(qi) {

    xmax <- qi * R

    box <- st_polygon(list(matrix(
      c(xmin, ymin,
        xmax, ymin,
        xmax, ymax,
        xmin, ymax,
        xmin, ymin),
      ncol = 2,
      byrow = TRUE
    )))

    intersection <- suppressWarnings(
      st_intersection(wing, box)
    )

    if (length(intersection) == 0) {
      0
    } else {
      as.numeric(st_area(intersection)) / total_area
    }
  })

  data.table(
    q = q,
    cumulative_area = cumulative_area
  )
}
```

```{r }
#| label: check-daves-regional-area
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| eval: true

polygon_area <- function(x, y) {
  
  # next point around polygon, including last -> first
  x2 <- c(x[-1], x[1])
  y2 <- c(y[-1], y[1])
  
  abs(sum(x * y2 - x2 * y) / 2)
}


regional_areas <- function(x, y) {
  
  # Total wing
  total <- polygon_area(x, y)
  
  # Proximal: 1 -> 2 -> 3 -> 4 -> 5 -> 37 -> 1
  prox_ind <- c(1:5, 37)
  proximal <- polygon_area(x[prox_ind], y[prox_ind])
  
  # Middle: 5 -> ... -> 12 -> 27 -> ... -> 37 -> 5
  mid_ind <- c(5:12, 27:37)
  middle <- polygon_area(x[mid_ind], y[mid_ind])
  
  # Distal: 12 -> ... -> 27 -> 12
  dist_ind <- 12:27
  distal <- polygon_area(x[dist_ind], y[dist_ind])
  
  data.table(
    area_total = total,
    area_prox = proximal,
    area_middle = middle,
    area_distal = distal,
    
    prop_prox = proximal / total,
    prop_middle = middle / total,
    prop_distal = distal / total,
    
    partition_error =
      (proximal + middle + distal) - total
  )
}
```

```{r }
#| label: import-wing-data

list_in <- "data/wing shape/wing_files_list.txt"
list_path <- here(list_in)
folder_list <- fread(list_path, sep = "\t",
                     header=FALSE)[[1]]

aero_labels <- c("area", "wing_length","mean_chord", "aspect_ratio", "xbar", "ybar", "xbar_hat", "Ixx", "Iyy", "Ixy", "r2", "r2_hat", "r2_hat_sq")
radii <- c(.1, 0.2, 0.3)
area_labels <- paste0("q", radii)
area_prop_labels <- c("prop_prox")
measure_labels <- c(aero_labels, area_labels, area_prop_labels)

wing_lm <- data.table(NULL) # wing landmarks
wing <- data.table(NULL) # wing metrics
for(i in 1:length(folder_list)){
  folder_i <- folder_list[i]
  rel_folder_path <- paste0("data/wing shape/",folder_i)
  folder_path <- here(rel_folder_path)
  files_short <- list.files( # just the file name
    path = folder_path,
    pattern = "\\.txt$",
    full.names = FALSE
  )
  files_long <- list.files( # full address
    path = folder_path,
    pattern = "\\.txt$",
    full.names = TRUE
  )
  n_files <- length(files_long)
  n_measures <- length(measure_labels)
  wing_measures <- matrix(NA, nrow = n_files, ncol = n_measures)
  colnames(wing_measures) <- measure_labels
  fig_mat <- matrix(NA, nrow = n_files, ncol = 37 * 2)
  colnames(fig_mat) <- c(paste0("x", 1:37),
                         paste0("y", 1:37))
  valid <- rep(FALSE, n_files)
  for(j in 1:n_files){
    lines <- readLines(files_long[j], warn = FALSE)
    lines <- lines[nzchar(trimws(lines))]
    n_landmarks <- length(lines) - 1
    
    if(n_landmarks != 37){
      cat(files_short[j], ":", n_landmarks, "landmarks\n")
      next
    }
    
    valid[j] <- TRUE
    
    fig_lm <- fread(files_long[j], nrows = 37,
                    header = FALSE)
    fig_lm[, V2 := -V2]
    
    # save lm to a matrix for the all fly_id in folder
    fig_mat[j,] <- c(unlist(fig_lm[, V1]),
                     unlist(fig_lm[, V2]))
    # compute wing metrics and save for all fly_id in folder
    aero_j <- wing_metrics(x = fig_lm[, V1],
                           y = fig_lm[, V2])
#    radial area distribution to compare to Harmon's thesis
    area_j <- radial_area_distribution(x = fig_lm[, V1],
                                       y = fig_lm[, V2],
                                       q = radii)
    regional_j <- regional_areas(
      x = fig_lm[, V1],
      y = fig_lm[, V2]
    )
    combined_j <- c(unlist(aero_j[1,]),
                    unlist(area_j[,2]),
                    unlist(regional_j[1, "prop_prox"])
    )
    wing_measures[j, ] <- combined_j
    
  }
  # delete empty rows
  # wing_measures <- na.omit(wing_measures)
  # fig_mat <- na.omit(fig_mat)
  files_short   <- files_short[valid]
  fig_mat       <- fig_mat[valid, , drop = FALSE]
  wing_measures <- wing_measures[valid, , drop = FALSE]
  
  # save landmarks
  # wing_lm <- rbind(
  #   wing_lm,
  #   data.table(
  #     file = str_remove(files_short, "\\.txt$"),
  #     temp = str_sub(files_short, 2, 2),
  #     line = str_sub(files_short, 3, 4),
  #     sex = str_sub(files_short, 5, 5),
  #     rep = str_sub(files_short, 6, 6),
  #     fly_id = str_extract(files_short, "(?<=^.{6})\\d{1,2}"),
  #     fig_mat
  #   )
  # )
  
#  save wing metrics
  wing <- rbind(
    wing,
    data.table(
      file = str_remove(files_short, "\\.txt$"),
      temp = str_sub(files_short, 2, 2),
      line = str_sub(files_short, 3, 4),
      sex = str_sub(files_short, 5, 5),
      rep = str_sub(files_short, 6, 6),
      fly_id = str_extract(files_short, "(?<=^.{6})\\d{1,2}"),
      wing_measures,
      fig_mat
    )
  )
}
```

```{r }
# get tps coords
  all_cols <- 1:37
```

```{r }
#| label: lmm-model
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| eval: true

# lmm
wing_metric_plot <- function(y_col = "area",
                             sex_i = "F"){
  r_form <- paste(y_col,
                  "~ treatment * temp * sex * rep +",
                  "(1 | line)") |>
    as.formula()
  area_lmm <- lmer(r_form, data = wing)
  sigma <- summary(area_lmm)$sigma
  # emm for statistics
  area_emm_pairs <- emmeans(
    area_lmm,
    ~ treatment | temp * sex
  )
  WT_means <- summary(area_emm_pairs)[summary(area_emm_pairs)$treatment == "WT", "emmean"]
  area_pairs <- contrast(
    area_emm_pairs,
    method = "revpairwise"
  ) |>
    summary(infer = TRUE) |>
    data.table()
  area_pairs[, d_perc := estimate / WT_means * 100]
  area_pairs[, d_std := estimate / sigma]
  area_pairs[, label := sprintf("\u0394 = %+.3f\n%+.1f%%\n%+.2f SD",
                              estimate, d_perc, d_std)]
  area_pairs[, x := as.integer(temp)]
  
  # plot treatment : temp : exp means
  area_emm <- emmeans(
    area_lmm,
    ~ treatment | temp * sex * rep
  )
  
  # compute rep : line means means
  line_means <- wing[, .(fit = mean(get(y_col))),
                     by = .(treatment, temp, rep,
                            line, sex)]
  # line_means <- expand.grid(
  #   line = levels(wing$line),
  #   sex = levels(wing$sex),
  #   temp = levels(wing$temp),
  #   rep = levels(wing$rep),
  #   treatment = levels(wing$treatment)
  # ) |>
  #   data.table()
  # line_means[, del := 0]
  # line_means[line %in% c("A1", "A2") & treatment == "WT", del := 1]
  # line_means[line %in% c("K4", "L4", "N6") & treatment == "SEL", del := 1]
  # line_means <- newdat[del == 0,]
  # line_means[, fit := predict(area_lmm, newdata = newdat)]
  line_means[, x_temp_treat := as.integer(temp) +
               (as.integer(treatment)-1.5)/2.5]
  line_means[treatment == "WT", x_temp_line_treat := x_temp_treat +
               (as.integer(line)-2)/10]
  line_means[treatment == "SEL", x_temp_line_treat := x_temp_treat +
               (as.integer(line)-4.5)/10]

  # raw data to plot
  plot_data <- wing[, .SD, 
                    .SDcols = c("temp", "treatment", "rep",
                                "line","sex", y_col)]
  plot_data[, x_temp_treat := as.integer(temp) +
              (as.integer(treatment)-1.5)/2.5 +
              rnorm(n=nrow(plot_data), mean = 0, sd = 0.01)]
  plot_data[treatment == "WT", x_temp_line_treat := x_temp_treat +
              (as.integer(line)-2)/10]
  plot_data[treatment == "SEL", x_temp_line_treat := x_temp_treat +
              (as.integer(line)-4.5)/10]
  # plot_data[, .(x = mean(x)), by = .(temp, treatment)]
  
  # emmeans to plot
  plot_emm <- area_emm |>
    summary() |>
    data.table()
  plot_emm[, x := as.integer(temp) +
             (as.integer(treatment)-1.5)/20]
  
  # y positions for annotation states
  max_y <- max(plot_data[sex == sex_i, get(y_col)])
  min_y <- min(plot_data[sex == sex_i, get(y_col)])
  add_y <- (max_y - min_y) * .05
  
  
  # plot it
  gg <- ggplot(data = plot_data[sex == sex_i],
               aes(x = x_temp_line_treat,
                   y = get(y_col),
                   color = treatment)) +
    # show the data
    geom_point() +
    
    # line means
    geom_point(data = line_means[sex == sex_i],
               aes(x = x_temp_line_treat,
                   y = fit,
                   shape = rep),
               size = 2,
               color = "black") +
    
    # treatment : temp means
    geom_point(data = plot_emm[sex == sex_i],
               aes(x = x,
                   y = emmean,
                   shape = rep),
               size = 3,
               color = "black") +
    geom_point(data = plot_emm[sex == sex_i],
               aes(x = x,
                   y = emmean,
                   color = treatment,
                   shape = rep),
               size = 2) +
    # geom_errorbar(data = plot_emm[sex == sex_i],
    #               aes(x = x,
    #                   y = emmean,
    #                   ymin = lower.CL,
    #                   ymax = upper.CL,
    #                   color = treatment)) +
    
    # annotation stats
    geom_text(
      data = area_pairs[sex == sex_i,],
      aes(x = x, y = max_y + 3*add_y, label = label),
      inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) + 
    
    scale_color_manual(values = pal_okabe_ito) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:3,
                       labels = c("23°", "26°", "29°")) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0.5, 3.5),
                    ylim = c(min_y - add_y, max_y + 4*add_y)) +
    theme_pubr() +
    theme(legend.position="none",
      axis.title.x = element_blank()) +
    NULL
  return(gg)
  
}
```

```{r}
#| label: percent-change-1
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| eval: false

percent_change <- function(y_label){
  r_form <- paste0("log(", y_label,
  ") ~ treatment * temp * sex * rep + (1 | line)")
  m1 <- lmer(r_form, data = wing)
  m1_emm <- emmeans(m1,
                    ~ treatment,
                    weights = "equal"
  )
#  m1_pairs <- contrast(m1_emm, method = "revpairwise")
  m1_pairs <- contrast(m1_emm, method = list("SEL - WT" = c(-1, 1)))
  pairs_dt <- m1_pairs |>
    summary() |>
    data.table()
  estimate <- pairs_dt[1, "estimate"]
  change <- 100 * (exp(estimate) - 1)
  return(unlist(c(estimate, change)))
}

change_matrix <- matrix(NA, nrow = 3, ncol = 2)
colnames(change_matrix) <- c("estimate", "percent")
change_matrix[1, ] <- percent_change("area")
change_matrix[2, ] <- percent_change("aspect_ratio")
change_matrix[3, ] <- percent_change("r2_hat_sq")
change_dt <- data.table(
  measure = c("area", "aspect_ratio", "r2_hat_sq"),
  change_matrix
)




```

```{r}
#| label: percent-change-2
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| eval: false
percent_change_2 <- function(y_label){
  r_form <- paste0("log(", y_label,
  ") ~ treatment * temp * rep * sex + (1 | line)")
  m1 <- lmer(r_form, data = wing)
  m1_emm <- emmeans(m1,
                    ~ treatment | temp * rep * sex
  )
  m1_pairs <- contrast(m1_emm, method = list("Sel - CN" = c(-1, 1)))
  m1_pairs_df <- as.data.frame(m1_pairs)
  m1_pairs_df$percent <- 100 * (exp(m1_pairs_df$estimate) - 1)
  return(m1_pairs_df)
}

keep_cols <- c("temp","sex","rep","percent")

res <- percent_change_2("area")
change_dt <- res[, keep_cols]
colnames(change_dt)[4] <- "area"

res <- percent_change_2("wing_length")
change_dt$wing_length <- as.data.frame(res)$percent

res <- percent_change_2("mean_chord")
change_dt$mean_chord <- as.data.frame(res)$percent

res <- percent_change_2("aspect_ratio")
change_dt$aspect_ratio <- as.data.frame(res)$percent

res <- percent_change_2("xbar_hat")
change_dt$xbar_hat <- as.data.frame(res)$percent

res <- percent_change_2("r2_hat_sq")
change_dt$r2_hat_sq <- as.data.frame(res)$percent

change_dt |>
  kable(digits = c(1)) |>
  kable_styling()
# clipr::write_clip(change_dt)
```
